O O O Ca O O O O CH3 CH3 O H2N O NH2 34 Analgesics Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Antipyretics Uses and Administration Carbasalate calcium is a 1:1 complex of calcium acetylsalicylate and urea. It is metabolised to aspirin after absorption and thus has the actions of aspirin (p.23). Carbasalate calcium is given in oral doses equivalent to about 400 to 800 mg of aspirin every 4 to 8 hours up to a maximum of about 3 g daily for pain or fever. Car- basalate calcium has also been used in the management of throm- boembolic disorders.
